reviewer: gpt-6-luna; independent static source/control-flow and bound-executable inspection

reviews.summary: The source selects one of five launchers by local average row length, then the timed runtime-count loop indirectly invokes that launcher once per repetition. Compiled evidence now includes the selector's function-pointer targets, timed indirect call/backedge, and all five actual launcher helper bodies (TPR 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), each of which launches its matching kernel specialization. Existing complete SASS evidence covers all five device variants.

source_evidence.claim: Parameterized CSR-vector kernel and launch template; selector thresholds; rank-local CSR setup and runtime-count timed calls followed by synchronization/output gather.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled selector maps averages to the five exact launcher targets; timed loop indirectly calls the selected target under the requested repetition counter and then copies/synchronizes; each target helper launches the corresponding CUDA kernel through cudaLaunchKernel.
All five selected TPR row-kernel SASS variants are cited through row/nonzero processing, arithmetic, and stores.

reviews.notes: The previous host excerpt covered the main loop but omitted the indirect launcher callees; these are now explicitly included.
